create_commerce.ponder.depot_lectern.tex: The Depot Lectern accepts items defined by the village's profile and pays out Spur in return.
Hoppers and funnels can push items into the lectern from any side except the front.
Items dropped onto the lectern from above are vacuumed in.
When a batch processes, Spur ejects from the front face.
If a Hopper or Chute sits directly below the lectern, Spur routes straight down into it instead of ejecting forward.
